subject.title: [UX/Bug] Model selection array order is strictly bound to checkbox ticking sequence, causing unintended primary/fallback assignment

question: Should this ClawHub issue be transferred or recreated in the OpenClaw runtime/configuration repository, kept here as ClawHub tracking, or closed after maintainer confirmation that no ClawHub action remains?
rationale: The reported behavior is concrete and aligned with OpenClaw priorities, but the affected runtime model picker and sync code are absent from this ClawHub checkout, so automation cannot safely choose repository ownership.

options.title: Transfer to runtime repo
options.body: Move or recreate the report where `openclaw configure`, model-role persistence, and Web UI synchronization are implemented, keeping this ClawHub item only as context if needed.

options.title: Keep as ClawHub tracking
options.body: Keep this issue open only if maintainers want ClawHub to track a registry, package, or CLI integration gap related to model-provider configuration.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Close only if a maintainer confirms there is no ClawHub-side action and the runtime report is tracked elsewhere or no longer wanted.

recommendation.title: Transfer to runtime repo
recommendation.body: Move or recreate the report where `openclaw configure`, model-role persistence, and Web UI synchronization are implemented, keeping this ClawHub item only as context if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest adjacent owner from current ClawHub CLI/config and repository-scope history, plus the author of the related CLI command-consolidation issue.
